Graded against the seven steps of the v4 Einstein 15-Minute Quote Call card, built 2026-10-02. v4 moved Two Promises from step 5 to step 3, rebalanced The Estimate from 10 points to 20 to cover Value Days and the pricing contrast, and merged 20 scored items down to 17. Scores do not convert from v3 — both the step boundaries and the weights moved.

1. Open10 pts
4
Asks the name, and uses it
Gets the customer's name AND actually uses it later in the call. Asked but never used again = partial. The greeting wording is a principle, not a script, and is not graded.
6
Quid pro quo
Time-boxed ask + promise of a dependable quote, and the rep waits for a yes before continuing. Partial if rushed past, zero if skipped.
2. Their Concerns  ·  BOOKEND ONE25 pts
8
Two-concerns question
New in v4, replacing the open-ended version. “Most people have one of two concerns: movers not showing up on time, or damage. Are either of those a concern for you?” Full if before probing.
12
Two layers deep
Real follow-up on a raised concern — “tell me more” — not one question and a pivot. Heaviest single item on the card. Full credit if no concern was ever raised.
5
Active listening reflection
“So what I'm hearing is ___, ___ and ___. Did I get all of it?” Full credit if no concerns were raised.
3. Two Promises10 pts
8
Lead-in + both promises
Merged in v4. Asks permission (“can I share how we work...”), then delivers the On-Time Guarantee ($50, then $25 per half hour) and No Worries Damage Coverage ($2,000, no deductible, built into the rate).
2
Closes the loop
“Does that put those to rest?” asked.
4. Probing for Details15 pts
11
Concern-led opening + logistics
Merged in v4. Opens on “what items are you most concerned about?”, then property type, floors, rooms, walking distance, additional rooms, special considerations, additional stops.
4
Packing + box count
Merged in v4. Both asked = full, one = partial, neither = zero.
5. The Estimate20 pts
7
Pricing framing
Three things: the pricing contrast (“can I share how we price?”, all-inclusive vs. add-on fees), the no-need-to-take-notes line, and fee transparency + the “not a guess” / 2.5-hour-minimum commitment.
5
Anchored, personalized estimate
A typical range AND personalized to this move, then stop and let them sit with the number. Range only = partial.
4
Value Days
New in v4. Correct branch for the day they picked, and any saving given as a TOTAL dollar figure, never an hourly difference, plus the flexibility ask. Full credit on a Best Value Day (nothing cheaper to offer).
4
Prep framing + temperature check
Save Your Ass prep framing, then “How do you feel about that?” with an actual pause. Replaces v3's “Does that feel fair?” — either phrasing is accepted.
6. Concerns Again  ·  BOOKEND TWO10 pts
5
Genuine final concerns check
“What's still concerning you about this move?” — not the throwaway “any questions?”
5
Follow-up + catch-all
Merged in v4. Digs in if something is raised, and asks “anything coming with you we haven't talked about?”
7. Ask for the Business10 pts
7
Rate lock, then the ask
Merged in v4, and the ORDER now counts. Rate lock and no deposit come first to give an easy yes, then “Would you like our help with your move?” asked plainly, never softened into an out.
3
Booking confirmed with details
Date, phone, window, crew size, addresses confirmed, and notes left for the crew. Full credit if the customer didn't book.

Walkthrough exception: calls cleanly routed to a virtual walkthrough before pricing (the step 1 branch, large moves) get steps 5–7 scored as full credit rather than zeroed — pricing was never supposed to happen on this call. Changed in v4: Two Promises is now step 3, before probing, so it IS graded on walkthrough calls (under v3 it was auto-credited). Steps 1–4 score normally. Only for a clean, by-design handoff, not a call that just trails off.
